calibration.sigma_interpretation: constant per-transition FP32 state standard deviation, NOT sigma0*sqrt(dt)

final_evaluation.noise: Frozen before calibration; distinct from calibration, prior NFT, later training; no checkpoint selection
final_evaluation.outcome: RL vs same stochastic sampler first; adoption/body/legal length/CF/FF/I and deterministic baseline separately

finish: Stop after gate failure or finite training+full evaluation; no default/commit/push

gate.body_review: Actual model-blind AI_PROXY all 256 POST; UNKNOWN not imputed YES; do not certify human quality
gate.if_no_sigma_passes: STOP without RL updates; retain complete negative calibration evidence
gate.origin: Preregistered bounded engineering viability thresholds chosen locally; not literature guarantees
gate.selection: Smallest sigma satisfying every gate; no ranking by best connection rate

nearest_prior: R29 NFT off-policy endpoint adaptation; now true windowed stochastic-action score-function learning, no endpoint regression

proposed_training.after_step_KL: old-buffer states, full joint Gaussian KL; diagnostic not extra loss
proposed_training.budget_status: User preference pending; freeze accepted or stated bounded default before training
proposed_training.deterministic_steps: physical LoRA bypass via reference branch; no trainable phi dependence
proposed_training.forward_precision: BF16 forward, FP32 parameters/integration; joint logpdf and KL arithmetic FP64
proposed_training.inactive_entire_batch: SKIP optimizer.step incl AdamW/momentum; count batch, no redraw or makeup
proposed_training.objective: RLOO REINFORCE one step per fresh batch; sum full d=9(N-K) joint logpdf and 20 steps; no sigma or d averaging
proposed_training.optimizer: fresh AdamW on rank4 alpha4 LoRA only; exact hyperparameters freeze before formal updates
proposed_training.reward: binary C_F_valid_edge_count>0 after same single official D0/GEO_C/source winding

scientific_retry: No automatic replay after a GPU failure; preserve attempts and decide explicit recorded engineering recovery within budget
